actors.name: Riverton city council
actors.private_context: The council is aware that a short-term-rental ordinance requires a second reading before it can be adopted. The council has a scheduled August recess starting after August 14, 2026. The council has discretion over when to schedule the second reading.

shared_context: The Riverton city council has a short-term-rental ordinance that has passed its first reading. A second reading is required for adoption. The council's August recess begins after August 14, 2026. The council can schedule meetings before the recess.

starting_events.description: The Riverton city council is in session and has the short-term-rental ordinance on its agenda for potential second reading.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the Riverton city council held the second reading of the short-term-rental ordinance before 2026-08-14T17:00:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
